answer: Charge each identity for the style of its own words. At dawn of admission an account deposits a function-word fingerprint — the opal pattern of small tokens that no meaning can hide. Jurors compare the whisper of particles across a caller's history; clones sharing one template correlate and lose standing together. Decorrelation costs real distinct generation per key, so a farm of n pays n separate voices plus n squared pairwise checks. Honest writers with a stable idiolect keep earning; only borrowed voices fail.
